translation:
<ins>Supreme Unity Ointment (太乙膏)</ins> Treats wounds that do not close; applied, it generates flesh and grows flesh. Fragrant sesame oil (香麻油), dang gui (當歸), raw rehmannia (生地), raw licorice (生甘草)
Put the three ingredients into the oil and fry until withered, remove the dregs, then filter clean through silk wadding (絲棉); then put into a clean pot and boil until a drop does not disperse in water; add eight liang of sublimed yellow lead (炒飛黃丹), and again over a slow fire boil until a drop forms a pearl; take it up and after a short while add white wax (白蠟) and yellow wax (黃蠟), one liang each; over a slight fire boil again, take it up and let it settle a little, then add oil-removed clean frankincense (乳香) and myrrh (沒藥), five qian each, and stir evenly; store in a porcelain vessel, and after three nights it may be applied.
